description: This file defines a module that manages the generation and resolution of plugin SDK facade modules and types for a larger project. It imports dependencies, processes source files, manages module resolution, and generates code for facades and type maps, including functions for collecting exports, resolving paths, and building module definitions.

methods.name: pluginSource
methods.description: Constructs a source URL string for a plugin given a directory name and optional artifact basename.

methods.name: runtimeApiSourcePath
methods.description: Generates the runtime API source path for a given plugin directory.

methods.name: listFacadeEntrySourcePaths
methods.description: Returns a list of unique source paths associated with a facade entry.

methods.name: buildFacadeSourceModuleKey
methods.description: Generates a unique module key string for a source at a given index.

methods.name: normalizeFacadeSourceParts
methods.description: Parses and normalizes the source path into directory name and artifact basename for local or package sources.

methods.name: collectRuntimeApiPreExports
methods.description: Reads a source file, parses export declarations, and collects export names from specific module specifiers.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceTypescriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the TypeScript path of a source file, checking for .ts or .tsx extensions.

methods.name: resolveFacadeModuleResolutionContext
methods.description: Creates and caches a TypeScript compiler context for module resolution, optionally based on a provided repository root.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceExportKinds
methods.description: Uses TypeScript APIs to analyze a source file and determine the types of its exported symbols.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeModule
methods.description: Builds a module string for a plugin facade, including imports, exports, and runtime loader functions based on facade entries and options.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeTypeMapModule
methods.description: Builds a TypeScript interface module that maps facade subpaths to their module types and exported symbols.
